svg.desc: Generated with MathJax 3.2.0 from this TeX (title, then body): \textbf{Listing 2}\quad \mathrm{D}{\small\mathrm{ECIDE}}(\mathcal{L}, q)\text{: the quote of MM}\_\text{algo1v2} \begin{array}{rll} {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 1} & \textbf{if }q\text{ rose since a bid at }B'\textbf{ then }\text{add the rise to the cost basis at }B' & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.1} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 2} & D \gets \min(D_{\max},\ n^b - 1,\ n^a - 1) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,2} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 3} & \textbf{if }D = 0\text{ or the book is crossed }\textbf{then return }\text{no quote} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 4} & x \gets \mathrm{clip}\bigl((q - q_{\min})/(q_{\max} - q_{\min}),\ 0,\ 1\bigr),\quad c \gets m\,\bigl(1 - \sigma(2x - 1)\bigr) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.2} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 5} & \textbf{for each }\delta \in \{\delta_{\min},\ \delta_{\min}\rho,\ \delta_{\min}\rho^2, \dots\},\ \delta \le \delta_{\max}\textbf{ do} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.4} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 6} & \hspace{1.4em}B \gets b_i + \epsilon\text{ at the first level }i \le D\text{ with }b_i \le c(1 - \delta)\ \ (\text{none: } \lfloor c(1 - \delta)\rfloor_\epsilon) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.5} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 7} & \hspace{1.4em}A \gets a_j - \epsilon\text{ at the first level }j \le D\text{ with }a_j \ge c(1 + \delta)\ \ (\text{none: } \lceil c(1 + \delta)\rceil_\epsilon) & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 8} & \hspace{1.4em}B \gets \min(B,\ a_0 - \epsilon),\quad A \gets \max(A,\ b_0 + \epsilon) & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 9} & \hspace{1.4em}p_b, p_a \gets\text{fill probabilities at the distances }(c - B)/c,\ (A - c)/c & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.6} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 10} & \textbf{if }x \ge x_{hi}\textbf{ then return }\text{the best lone ask, or no quote} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.9} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 11} & \textbf{if }x \le x_{lo}\textbf{ then return }\text{the best lone bid, or no quote} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 12} & \textbf{for each }\text{pair }(B, A)\textbf{ do} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.7} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 13} & \hspace{1.4em}R \gets (1 - f)^2 A/B - 1,\quad J \gets p_b\, p_a R - \eta\,\bigl[p_b(1 - p_a) + p_a(1 - p_b)\bigr] & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.8} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 14} & (B, A) \gets\text{the pair with the largest }J\text{ among those with }R > r_{\min},\ J > J_{\min} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 15} & \textbf{if }\text{there is none }\textbf{then }\text{the best feasible lone leg, else }\textbf{return }\text{no quote} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 16} & \text{per side, keep the last price while the new one is within }w\text{ of it} & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.10} \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 17} & \hspace{1.4em}\text{and the kept quote is younger than }T_r\text{ and still clears the bar} & \\[3pt] {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle 18} & \textbf{return }(B, A) & {\color{#6e7781}\scriptstyle \S\,8.11} \end{array}
